title: The effort moves, it does not vanish

where-did-the-time-go.title: Where did the time go
where-did-the-time-go.keywords: where did the time go, saved typing, not twenty times faster
where-did-the-time-go.script: So where did the time go? You saved all that typing, and yet you did not feel twenty times faster. That is the question, and the answer is the whole learning goal in one line.
